I would also like to express special thanks to Kanubhai Vrundavanbhai Bhagat (of Chalamli) for his cooperation in proofreading during the publication of this book. I offer the blessing that the boundless grace of Sadguru Shri Jivanji Maharaj may rest upon his family.

The Sadguru Shri Jivanji Maharaj Memorial Foundation is bringing out several more new publications in the time ahead, and we are receiving immense, selfless cooperation from society for this work -- for which we, in turn, thank society here. For books and other publications, you may also reach us through our website: www.ramkabir.guru and www.ramkabir.org. Very soon, all of our literature will be made available online through the website. Some books can already be downloaded and read on the Google Play Store; our efforts to bring them to the Apple iPhone platform are under way. Through our website we aim to provide information useful to society, and for this we seek society's continued cooperation.

Your well-wisher,
Swami Premjivan Jagdishchandra
Dated: 4 April 2019
Vadodara.

By the grace of the eternally illustrious Shri Jivanji Maharaj.

Kirtan of Shri Padmanabhji, by Adhyaruji

_Devahutikun Jivana bhaye Kapil Muni avatar,
Dattatray Yaduke bhaye | Padmanabh Dhanraj ||1||_ (To Devahuti, O Jivan, was born the incarnation of sage Kapil Muni; to Yadu was born Dattatreya -- and now, in this age, he has come as Padmanabh Dhanraj.)

_Aap aapna liya olkhi | Padmanabh Dhanraj,
Swami sevak mali Jivana | kiyo bhaktko kaj ||2||_ (He recognized His own as His own -- Padmanabh Dhanraj; Master and servant met, O Jivan, and the devotee's work was done.)

_Adhyaru Patan bhaye | Raykhanke Diwan,
Padmanabhki pritma | chhod diya sab maan ||3||_ (Adhyaru became, in Patan, the Diwan [minister] to Raykhan; but out of love for Padmanabh, he gave up all worldly honor.)

_Jug sarapo jogade | Gurjar khand gumar,
Shap utaro Jivana | lino Padmanabh avatar ||4||_ (The age had wearied and laid a curse upon the guileless land of Gujarat; to lift that curse, O Jivan, the incarnation of Padmanabh was taken.)

_Kaljag bahot kripa kari | Surat dhari mere shaam,
Patanma padhariya | Padmanabhji naam ||5||_ (In this Kali age he showed abundant grace, and my dark Lord took manifest form; he arrived in Patan under the name Padmanabhji.)

_Dhanya dhanya Padmanabhne | Jangalna chho rasiya,
Aagal paachal jhaad jhundne | vachma pote vasiya ||6||_ (Blessed, blessed is Padmanabh -- you delight in the forest wilds; with trees and groves all around, he himself dwelt in their midst.)

|| Samput ||

_Swami kripa karo ati ghani || Swami || bhajo anek vichar ||
Achal bhakti de taheri | je chhe mukti bhandar || paaye ||1||_ (O Master, bestow Your grace most abundantly -- O Master -- and break apart my many scattered thoughts. Grant me unwavering devotion to You, which is the very treasury of liberation -- may it be attained.)

|| Aarti ||

_Anand aarti harakh apara | Harijan aaye mere pran adhara._ (This is the aarti of bliss, joy beyond measure -- the devotees of Hari [Harijan] have come, the very support of my life.)

_Santo darshan mere tran tap nivare | Janam maran bhavsagar taro ||1||_ (The sight of the saints removes my three afflictions; it carries me across the ocean of birth and death.)

_Shaak paak mali bhojan pavo | Sant sangat mali harigun gaavo._ (Together we take a meal of vegetables and bread; together, in the company of saints, we sing the praises of Hari.)

_Gher gher mangal hot badhai | Jan-Jivan tahan bal bal jai ||2||_ (In every home there is rejoicing and cries of congratulation; there Jan-Jivan -- the poet's own signature, "the servant Jivan" -- offers himself again and again in devotion.)

|| Salutations to Ramkabir ||
|| By the grace of the revered Shri 108 Jivanji Maharaj ||
|| Here begin the kirtans composed by the revered Shri Adhyaruji Maharaj ||
